metadata.description: FindBroadband's UK broadband apps for AI assistants: deals at your address and an internet outage checker.

plugins.name: findbroadband-deals
plugins.description: Compare the UK broadband deals available at an exact address, priced on their true whole-contract cost, and check whether a bill or renewal quote is too high.

plugins.name: internet-outage-checker
plugins.description: Check whether a UK broadband provider is down and where, plus its outages over the last 30 days.
